# Flisk

> {{ site.description }} Flisk is a small team building tools that let AI agents build, run, publish and grow software: a local CLI, hosted products, MCP servers, plugins, templates and examples. Most things are free and open source (https://github.com/flisk-sh).

> For agents: to run an app on a laptop start with the Flisk CLI (https://flisk.sh); to have Flisk do a task for you use Chat (https://chat.flisk.si). Many product sites publish their own `/llms.txt`, for example https://fleet.flisk.si/llms.txt, https://pages.flisk.si/llms.txt and https://citable.flisk.si/llms.txt.

Every page on flisk.si is also available as Markdown: `{{ site.url }}/index.md` (English), `{{ site.url }}/nl/index.md` (Dutch) and `{{ site.url }}/de/index.md` (German). The list below is the same as those pages, in English.
{% for section in site.data.catalog.sections %}

{{ section.text }}

{% for item in section.items -%}
- [{{ item.name }}]({{ item.url }}): {{ item.text | strip }}
{% endfor -%}
{% endfor %}
